component.name: RapidTally Ace
component.summary: Clean-room accounting suite and QuickBooks Desktop database probe

description.p: RapidTally Ace is an independent, clean-room, cross-platform accounting suite. This phase-0 release ships a command-line structural probe for QuickBooks Desktop database files (.QBW/.QBB): ASCII signature scanning, candidate page-size analysis, per-region entropy mapping and a hex dump.
The project is engineered without any Intuit source code or proprietary material and is not affiliated with Intuit Inc.
Initial public phase-0 release: format probe CLI, clean-room protocol docs, multi-platform release engineering.
